_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 3 (B26, D4/§5) — layers a little Create andesite alloy (the mod's basic crafting material) onto the Magitech Workshop's chest. Inert without Create: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Gate-safe: andesite_alloy is trivially craftable and never skips the andesite->brass grind (never brass / precision mechanisms).
